name: camino rural
promptText: Wide-angle rural landscape under bright direct midday light, establishing a high-key monochromatic palette of greys and whites. Camera height is eye-level, slightly elevated looking across. Foreground planes feature detailed dry, coarse grasses interspersed with small rocks and varying wild plants like ferns and low shrubs. A prominent weathered wooden post and barbed-wire fence recedes precisely in perspective across the midground. Behind it, a vast empty field recedes into a flat, distant horizon line featuring a few sparse, small trees. Above the horizon, a large expanse of clear, open sky fills the upper frame. Materialien reflect dry earth, rustic metal, aged wood, and natural foliage textures. Edge-to-edge, immersive, borderless framing with ample clear ground and sky zones for character and text overlays.
